column2: A demon guarding the treasure in an ancient king's tomb. If the treasure is stolen, it wakes and attacks the thief.[end]
A super strong, wise demon with horns on its head. It looks scary, but it loves nature and is very gentle.[end]
A giant demon with many super strong arms. A god who feared its strength sealed it away.[end]
An owl demon, once a baby who turned into a bird to fly off in search of its mom. Its cry sounds just like a human baby's.[end]
A one-legged, fire-breathing crane that burns anything it touches. A pesky demon that starts fires.[end]
A heartless demon with a head and long beak like a bird's. It tears the bodies of the dead to pieces.[end]
Twin dog demons with a strong sense of justice. They never forgive evil demons, and guard the barriers of shrines.[end]
A little demon that sneaks into people's hearts to tempt them. But it's timid and runs off if you get a bit mad.[end]
An angel of victory whose name means "power of God." It bears arms and hunts evil demons to protect the world.[end]
An angel who rides a chariot across the sky to punish bad demons and humans. Its body shines like metal, and it has four faces.[end]
A demon born from a snowman. With a cute smile and innocent laugh, it plays around with ice magic.[end]
A ninja demon like a flying squirrel. It can fly for a long time and run super fast.[end]
A baby demon made of snow, carried in by the Yuki-Onna on snowy nights. Its nose is always runny.[end]
A god of the underground with a spear and shield. A proud demon with a dignified, noble look.[end]
A pumpkin-headed fire demon living deep in swamps and forests. It leads people astray and drags them into bottomless swamps.[end]
A dog demon and brother of Cerberus. It's very kind-hearted, but in battle it breathes fire and fights proudly.[end]
A winged girl demon who is always hungry. Her beautiful, clear singing voice tempts all who hear it.[end]
A cheerful demon that sits still in the forest by day, but strolls through town with fireballs at night.[end]
A knight demon who wields a spear called Gae Bolg. Very serious, he never breaks a promise.[end]
A dog demon that always spins in circles biting its own tail. It loves doing pointless things.[end]
A cruel demon who appears at sea, tempting sailors with her beautiful voice and sinking their ships.[end]
A twisted tiger demon and a sore loser. Once it starts a fight, it won't stop until it wins.[end]
